column1: # Verified against a real HRRR f03 file: idx names below match its .idx
# short_name is what eccodes reports for that record. Ranges and cutoffs come
# from that file's own value distribution. Only the first 18 forecast hours are
# offered because that is what every hourly cycle publishes (00/06/12/18z also
# go to 48 -- raise max_forecast_hour in model.json if you only use those).
# 79% of cells sit at the -10 dBZ "no echo" floor
# 58% of cells are exactly 0; hide them rather than paint them the palette's floor colour.
